name: Bank of India
summary: Bank of India provides various banking products and services in India and internationally. It operates through Treasury; Wholesale Banking; and Retail Banking segments. The company accepts various deposit products, such as savings, salary, current, term, and rera account deposits. It also provides debit, credit, and prepaid cards; personal, home, vehicle, education, star reverse mortgage, and home loans, as well as loans against property; and finance to new and existing business, healthcare schemes, government sponsored schemes, and commercial vehicle finance services.
